messages:
maria.partner: Quick sync — finalizing marketplace listing + joint GTM. Proposed embargo: 2025-11-12 16:00 PT. Need press-ready assets, landing hero, and SI integration checklist by EOD Tue. @alex.gtm @samir_prod @jules_eng

alex.gtm: Copy ack. I can fold a one-paragraph announce + CTA and a short blog draft. Will drop links by tomorrow morning.

samir_prod: On SI checklist — I need the final API contract and sample manifest from eng. @jules_eng can you confirm the schema?
jules_eng: Yep, schema is stable. Will paste the minimal manifest here in a sec:

```
{
  "integration": "redwood-marketplace",
  "version": "v1",
  "auth": "oauth2",
  "endpoints": ["/v1/models","/v1/embeddings"]
}
```

jules_eng: Also pushed a staging microsite to https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace-tenant for previews.

nancy_ops: Staging link works for me. Launch-bot scheduled a dry run for 2025-11-10 09:00 PT — reminder will post in #release-war-room.

launch-bot: DRY RUN CREATED — ID: dr-1765439 — 2025-11-10T09:00:00-08:00 — Participants: maria.partner, alex.gtm, samir_prod, jules_eng, nancy_ops

maria.partner: Thanks. Small request from partner PMs: include hardware partner badge placements (2x) and a one-line co-sell blurb under hero. Can we get creative with the hero subhead? Suggestion: "Enterprise-grade LLM serving — predictable cost, consistent latency." Thoughts?

alex.gtm: I like it. For press embargo copy: short headline + TL;DR + partner quote. I'll ping legal for embargo window wording.

samir_prod: For SI scoping doc: I'll create a checklist for on-prem handoffs, KMS integration, and private deployment notes. Will attach a template by EOD.

jules_eng: One tech ask — confirm model variant fallback policy in the listing (e.g., rwd-medium -> rwd-small). That drives routing logic for Dedicated vs Hosted. If we include it, customers won't be surprised.

maria.partner: Good call. Include a short bullet: "Automatic fallback to verified compatible model variants during capacity constraints."

nancy_ops: Ops note: Provisioning window for tenants with reserved capacity is 48 hours after contract signature. Need legal to confirm the SLA blurb for the marketplace listing.

alex.gtm: Putting together a content timeline:
- Tue morning: blog draft + hero assets link
- Tue evening: partner logos + quotes in Figma
- Wed morning: press embargo PDF + distribution list to press ops
- Thu: final signoff + marketplace publish (post-embargo)

maria.partner: Solid. If anyone has blockers call out now. Otherwise I'll consolidate assets and send the embargo to PR/legal tomorrow. :thumbsup:

jules_eng: No blockers from eng. I'll add the manifest + fallback note to the marketplace metadata file.

samir_prod: Template for SI checklist uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/si-template (permissions open to partners).

alex.gtm: One micro ask — can we make the landing CTA read: "Try Redwood Inference on the Marketplace" instead of just "Get started"? Slightly more discoverable for partners.

maria.partner: Yeah, change accepted. Alex — update the hero and CTA on staging and re-share link.

launch-bot: REMINDER — Dry run in 48 hours (2025-11-10 09:00 PT). Please confirm attendance in #release-war-room.
